products.title: Stress Release & Restorative Yoga Therapy | Anxiety Relief & Nervous System Reset (On-Demand Course)
products.body_html:
Give yourself permission to pause, and do absolutely nothing.

When chronic stress leaves you feeling tight in the chest, easily irritated, or chronically fatigued, your nervous system is sending an SOS signal. This zero-effort course requires no physical exertion. By using props such as yoga blocks and bolsters to fully support your body, you will engage in long-held passive stretches to achieve cellular-level relaxation and deep nervous system repair.

Who is this for?
  • Burnout & High Stress: Individuals dealing with chronic stress, constant anxiety, or experiencing mental and physical burnout.
  • Emotional Fluctuation: Those prone to mood swings, anxiety attacks, panic, or a frequent sense of shortness of breath.
  • Gentle Movement Seekers: People who dislike high-intensity, sweaty workouts and simply want to find inner peace and security through yoga.
  • Recovery & Gentle Care: Those recovering from illness or injury, or during their menstrual cycle, who need an extremely gentle and nurturing practice.
Curriculum:
  • Session 1: Anxiety Rescue – Calming the Tense Nerves
    Utilize Box Breathing paired with a fully supported Child’s Pose to rapidly lower cortisol (the stress hormone) levels.
  • Session 2: Tension Release – Shoulder & Chest Expansion
    Use yoga blocks for passive support to gently open a tight chest, instantly allowing your breath to become deeper and fuller.
  • Session 3: Grounding into Safety – Supported by Mother Earth
    Allow a bolster to carry your body weight in a forward fold, activating your parasympathetic nervous system and rebuilding a sense of inner security.
  • Session 4: Detox & Therapy – Deep Twist & Release
    A gentle, supported reclined twist that offers a micro-massage to your abdominal organs, helping to release bottled-up negative emotions.
  • Session 5: Deep Restoration – Zero-Gravity Ultimate Relaxation
    With the help of a chair or wall, settle into a fully supported Savasana (corpse pose) to experience a weightless state of "floating on a cloud."
What's Included:


  • 5 High-Definition On-Demand Videos: 30-minute restorative therapy sessions per class.
  • Lifetime Unlimited Access: Watch anytime, anywhere, whenever you need an instant "anxiety rescue."
  • Exclusive Digital Bonus: A downloadable PDF pocketbook: 3-Minute Desktop Breathing Exercises for Quick Stress Relief.
